images.caption: Figure 1:3D-Grounded Scene Generation.(a) Our 3DRAE repurposes frozen 2D foundation models to ground varying number of views into fixed-length implicit 3D latent tokens, which can be queried to decode images and point maps of various views including novel views. (b) Our 3DDiT performs diffusion modeling directly in this implicit 3D latent space, enabling 3D-grounded generation with superior efficiency and spatial consistency.

Figure 2:We empirically find that overlapping regions across multiple views correspond to the same set of tokens. Therefore, we employ fixed-length 3D latent tokens to eliminate such multi-view redundancy.

Figure 4:Qualitative Comparison.Top: Comparison with state-of-the-art methods.Bottom: Comparison between our 3DRAE and 3DDiT to demonstrate the effectiveness of diffusion modeling, where 3DRAE fails in 1-view setting that prioritizes generation capability. The red bounding boxes highlight failure cases in baselines.
